findings.title: Charged wood tank zeroes 4 of 5 space-only multi-start seeds; mild two-zone days ship the all-off plan
findings.claim: On a two-tank (wood) two-zone house without DHW, HeatPumpOptimizer's space-only solve hands _multi_start_minimize 4 all-zero starts of 5 in 32 of the 60 cells of this seat's axis, and on the 5 mild 24 h cells it ships a 0 kWh plan that a one-run challenger beats by 1.47-2.03 objective units with no feasibility loss.
findings.mechanism: optimizer.py (space-only path, ~line 5507): seed_power = baseline_power * (1 - _wood_covered_share(...)); a tank that covers the thermostat reference gives share 1.0, so seed_power, baseline_energy and the three _price_ranked_start vectors built from baseline_energy (full, low, deep-low) are all zero. Only the price-weighted initial guess is live, and the all-off point is a stationary basin for the relaxed descent (the start term is not in the relaxed objective, and a run below the 1 kW floor is clipped by the candidate stage), so the multi-start has no start inside the one-run basin the true objective prefers.

evidence.unit: objective units (J_prod - J_best, max over the 5 gap cells; census: 32 of 60 cells with 4/5 zero starts)
evidence.contention_note: counts and objective values; contention-immune (D0-s2 M6 loops and D3/D9 seats running)

perturbation.change: WOOD_SHARE_OFF=1: optimizer._wood_covered_share patched to return 0.0 (seed from the reference unscaled)
perturbation.observed_value: gap_abs 2.029/1.678/1.631/1.468 -> 0.000 on the four summer_cool cells, 1.725 -> 0.577 on winter_typical/shoulder; census all-but-one-zero cells 32 -> 4, zero starts 128 -> 16 (the 4 left are summer_warm/6h, which needs no heat)

findings.metric_definition: gap_abs = J_prod - J_best feasible challenger (race.py arms seeds/warm, production objective); zero_starts = all-zero candidates in the space-only multi-start call
findings.phenomenon_property: The space-only multi-start's structured starts must not collapse to the all-zero vector because a free heat source covers the thermostat reference: at least one start besides the price-weighted guess carries energy whenever the shipped horizon can need heat.

null_control.note: Survives flat prices: the gap is not price optimality but solver structure (seed collapse); named so per D0.M5. Bills on these days are ~0 SEK of energy: the gap is the objective's comfort-pull term (challenger buys 3.0-5.1 kWh).

reproduction_steps: run the --race command with and without WOOD_SHARE_OFF=1
findings.proposed_fix_scope: optimizer.py space-only seeding: keep the wood-scaled seed and add an unscaled (or floor-level single-run) start, so a covered reference cannot empty the seed set; the DHW path (_solve_space) does not scale and is untouched.

non_findings.claim: No multi-start budget gap: no L-BFGS-B run inside any production multi-start call stopped on its iteration limit in any of the 1220 cells, so the 4x maxiter arm never differs
One-shot price gaps are masked by MPC: across the 60 gap cells whose first action differs, the closed loop realises no systematic gain for the augmented challenger
non_findings.value: realised gap median +0.029 pct, 29 positive / 28 negative / 3 within tolerance; realised energy gap mean 0.051 SEK per cell-day; loop flat null on the same cells -2.58..+2.26 pct (as large as priced); plant error 1.25 flips sign on 3 of 4; 2-day Jr gap -0.94..+0.58 pct

non_findings.claim: Largest price-attributable one-shot gaps on large bills stay under the brief's bar: winter_cold two-zone 24/48 h cells 0.5-1.0 pct of J on 45-182 SEK horizons, flat null ~0, realised 0.04-0.5 pct
non_findings.value: m4_plane_mean_gap_loo mean 0.083 pct, drop-most-favourable 0.072 pct over 20 price x weather planes

non_findings.claim: flow-setpoint-behind-valve: the plan leaves the minimum level, more where a price spread exists
non_findings.value: on-steps above min+0.05 kW: 0.693 (winter prices) vs 0.611 (flat) over 185 pairs; never above min in 2 of 240 cells; plan identical to valve-storage in 240/240 pairs (the flow set-point is actuation, not planning)

non_findings.claim: manual-valve-buffer: the plan differs from the same cell with no store
non_findings.value: identical in 0 of the 184 cells that use heat (54 identical cells all ship 0 kWh); median L1 4.21 kWh

non_findings.claim: Coordinator captures carry no gap at winter prices
Harness gap recorded (not a production defect): a wood cell without a tank reading runs the manual-valve plant
non_findings.value: 59/59 wood plans identical to manual-valve-buffer with wood_tank_temperature None; two-tank layout needs two zones (thermal_model.ThermalParameters.topology_layout) so single-zone wood is manual-valve by design

leads.what: D0-s2-01's seed collapse is price-independent (it survives flat at 1.678 objective units): the two-zone no-DHW wood cells on summer/shoulder/flat prices likely carry the same all-off plan; measure with dev/audit/rounds/round11/D0/s2/wood_seeds.py --census over that axis.
A cell builder that does not set the wood tank reading drives the manual-valve plant, not wood (59/59 identical plans here); D0-s3's wood cells need the reading set before they count as examined.
